descriptionlist.description: Renders falling snowflakes across iOS or restricted to the Home/Lock Screen wallpaper and CarPlay lockout screens.
Updated for iOS 15-16+ rootless jailbreaks (Dopamine & Palera1n) with SBWindowScene-attached touch-passthrough overlay windows.
Includes battery-friendly CAEmitterLayer particle mode and high-quality 3D CABasicAnimation snowflake mode.
Live preference updates via Darwin notifications apply instantly without requiring a respring.

changelog.change: Added SBWindowScene attachment for iOS 16+ full-screen touch-passthrough overlay
Live preference reload via Darwin notifications without respringing
